text.p: A Romanian finance ministry issue of 300.16 billion lei three-month treasury bills was oversubscribed on Thursday with banks' bids exceeding the offer by 13.25 billion, central bank data showed.
The T-bills, offering an annual yield of 49.6 percent, mature on January 30, 1997.

Banca Comerciala Romana SA, Banca Franco-Romana SA, Bancorex SA, Bankcoop SA, Banca Ion Tiriac SA, Casa de Economii si Consemnatiuni, Eximbank SA, Banca Agricola SA and the Bucharest units of Dutch banks ING Bank and ABN Amro, and their corporate clients bought the new paper.
Results of subscriptions are available on BNR01. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
